findings.title: T9 concentrates recall
findings.body: One turn re-surfaces A58410's card/route, the earlier docx note, the SEA→SFO flight and the cart — several Memory › Read-from-working-memory chips joined to the probe.

component_timeline.title: Component calls per turn — which components fire under each memory query
component_timeline.overview: 4 turns surface a probed entity (flagged). Of those, 3 answered with NO retrieval component (working-memory recall); the rest re-invoked retrieval.

memory_queries.title: How the harness reacted to the 15 injected memory queries
